title: The Wobbly Wheel
logline: A wheelbarrow wheel wobbles. Fix-It measures, finds the bent pin, and replaces it with one machined to fit.
friction_source: A worn part with a hidden cause
character_want: Fix-It wants the cart trustworthy again
power_usage: No powers exist in this concept
escalation: Wrong-size pins tried in turn, each failing measurably
emotional_beat: The cart rolls true; quiet pride
rewatch_detail: The wrong pins line up by size in the background
distinctness_note: Control sample: deterministic prop physics, no atmospheric states

title: The Gate That Wouldn't Latch
logline: The garden gate swings open in wind. Fix-It realigns the latch after diagnosing a sagging post.
friction_source: A structural sag defeats a simple latch
character_want: Fix-It wants the boundary to hold
escalation: Latch adjustments fail until the post itself is straightened
emotional_beat: The click of the latch as payoff
rewatch_detail: The sag is visible in the opening wide shot
distinctness_note: Control sample: diagnose-then-fix pattern, props deterministic

title: The Leaky Watering Can
logline: The watering can dribbles from its seam. Solder attempts fail twice; the can is retired to planter duty and a new can is earned.
friction_source: A repair that will not hold
character_want: Fix-It wants every tool savable
escalation: Patch fails, solder fails, seam splits wider
emotional_beat: The old can becomes a planter; letting a tool retire is framed as respect
rewatch_detail: The planter-can appears in later backgrounds
distinctness_note: Control sample: repair-fails-then-reframe pattern

title: The Counterweight Crane
logline: A branch too heavy to lift is moved with a counterweight crane built from the workbench scrap bin.
friction_source: Mass exceeds strength
character_want: Fix-It wants the clever solution to work
escalation: Lever fails, pulley slips, counterweight holds
emotional_beat: The branch rises slowly; applause from nobody, pride anyway
rewatch_detail: The scrap bin's contents are consistent across episodes
distinctness_note: Control sample: applied-physics build episode

title: The Squeak Census
logline: Three things squeak in the shed. Fix-It oils two and locates the third: a mouse-free hinge that turns out to be the door itself, pleased to be oiled.
friction_source: Three similar symptoms, three different causes
character_want: Fix-It wants a quiet shed
escalation: Oiling by schedule fails until each squeak is matched to its source
emotional_beat: Silence, then a new squeak, tolerated
rewatch_detail: The third squeak's rhythm matches the door swing from scene one
distinctness_note: Control sample: diagnostic pattern with sensory clues

title: The Delivery of Parts
logline: A crate of ordered parts arrives without labels. Sorting by shape, thread, and weight becomes the episode's game.

title: The Shelf Above the Bench
logline: A new shelf must go above the bench. Measuring twice still cuts once wrong; the offcut becomes a bracket, and the shelf holds.
friction_source: A measuring error discovered late
character_want: Fix-It wants the shelf level
escalation: Mismeasure, recut, the spirit level's slow bubble as judge

title: The Borrowed Wrench
logline: The one right wrench is lent to the stall; the job can't wait. Improvised tools fail gently until the wrench is walked back with a trade.

title: The Painted Line
logline: A straight white line for the path edge wobbles. A string guide fixes the line; the one intentional wobble around the sprout stays.
friction_source: The ideal line meets an obstacle worth keeping
character_want: Fix-It wants the line true
escalation: Chalk, string, stakes; the sprout forces one planned curve

title: The Storm Prep
logline: Wind is forecast by the flag. Fix-It ties, latches, and weights everything down; the garden survives; the checklist is the hero.
starting_goal: Secure the yard before the blow
friction_source: A deadline set by the world's weather
character_want: Fix-It wants readiness to be enough
power_usage: None; weather is the world's, never a character's
escalation: Each checklist item is tested by a stronger gust front
emotional_beat: One thing was forgotten (the sign), found safe anyway by luck, noted honestly on the list
rewatch_detail: The flag's angle steepens scene by scene as the front nears
distinctness_note: Control sample: preparation-montage episode against world weather

title: The Star Log
logline: Lumina records one star each night in a log. Tonight's star is hidden by cloud; the log entry becomes a drawing of the gap, honestly labeled.
friction_source: The observation target is obscured

title: The Moon Phases Mobile
logline: Lumina builds a hanging model of moon phases; the real moon tonight disagrees with where the mobile was left, and the mobile is re-hung to match.
starting_goal: Align the model with the sky
friction_source: The model drifts out of sync with reality
character_want: Lumina wants the model to tell the truth

title: The Quietest Hour
logline: Lumina tries to find the quietest hour of the night for listening. Each candidate hour has its own sound; the log becomes a map of night voices.
friction_source: Silence does not exist; attention reclassifies sounds

title: The Shadow at Noon
logline: Lumina chases her own noon shadow to measure it; it is shortest at noon, obviously, and the chase itself is recorded as the finding.
friction_source: The measurement is entangled with the measurer
character_want: Lumina wants the smallest shadow caught precisely
escalation: Hourly marks around a standing stone; the noon mark is the smallest circle
emotional_beat: The spiral of marks is left as a garden feature
rewatch_detail: The shadow's length is consistent with the sun in every scene
distinctness_note: Control sample: measurement ritual as calm content

title: The Dream Shelf

title: The Map of Sounds

title: The Longest Night Treat
logline: For the longest night, Lumina prepares a slow cocoa ritual; the ritual takes so long the night is half over, which is declared the point.
